pages.title: Jack In The Box by Schylling
pages.description: Jack-in-the-Box by Schylling: turn the handle, hear the music, and watch the plush character pop out. Ages 18 months+.
pages.ld_description:
Jack-in-the-Box - Regular

Classic metal jack-in-the-box toy with bright colours and cheerful design.
Turn the handle to hear the music play - then watch the surprise pop out!
Encourages anticipation, motor skills, and early cause-and-effect learning.
Includes soft plush character inside, safe for young children.
Durable, nostalgic design loved by generations.
Suitable for ages 18 months and up.

A timeless toy that brings delight and giggles - perfect for sharing joy and surprise with the littlest learners.
